gaps.cause: missing fund column; missing lines (nonoperating receipts recorded as revenue)
gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Governmental Funds, modified cash) Total Receipts 367,449.04 = General 255,270.31 + Street 96,120.76 + Keno 14,320.97 + PCI 1,737.00. Detail revenue (543,987) = General Fund departments schedule p10 receipts 255,271 (cells; printed total 255,270) + the schedule's NONOPERATING RECEIPTS (p11: TIF receipts 51,992 + 162,764, Donations 580 + 67,260 + 1,330, Interest income 3,030 + 68 + 1,645 + 13 + 34 = 288,716; detail 18-27). (1) Missing fund columns: Street, Keno and PCI print receipts only on the statement (the p9 budget schedule prints revenues for all funds combined): Street Property taxes 19,304.01, Motor vehicle 1,866.33, Other (taxes) 1,721.85, Intergovernmental 72,828.57, Other 400.00 = 96,120.76; Keno proceeds 14,320.97; PCI Other 1,737.00; added = 112,178.73. (2) The statement prints TIF receipts 214,755.46, Donations 69,170.00 and Interest income 5,777.81 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not in Total Receipts; the 10 detail lines are moved to section other financing (removed and re-added with the same fund/department/amount), plus the Keno column's Interest income 987.93 (p4 other financing) which no detail line had. Check: 543,987 + 112,178.73 - 288,716 = 367,449.73 vs 367,449.04 (0.69 = whole-dollar rounding). NOTE for the apply step: the statement has two receipt lines labelled 'Other' (taxes 11,175.58 and other 18,748.72); the added Street 'Other' 400.00 and PCI 'Other' 1,737.00 are non-tax rows (category other), the Street 'Other' 1,721.85 is the tax row (category taxes).

gaps.cause: missing lines (interest expense recorded as expenditure)
gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Total Disbursements 420,636.86 = General 327,106.02 + Street 63,175.76 + Keno 14,643.90 + PCI 15,711.18. Detail expenditure 512,241 = departments schedule pp10-11 Total Disbursements 418,710 + budget schedule p9 Streets 63,176 + Keno 14,644 + PCI 15,711. The departments schedule counts Debt Service Interest 91,604 (TIF Projects, p11; detail 66) inside Total Disbursements, while the statement prints it as 'Interest expense (91,603.56)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (General column 327,106.02 = 418,710 - 91,604). Fix: move detail 66 to section other financing (removed, re-added as -91,604). Check: 512,241 - 91,604 = 420,637 vs 420,636.86.
